How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.

**Context:**
The Prophet said: 'Whoever awakes at night and then says:

title: When waking up (3/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
رَبِّ اغفر لي.

**Transliteration:**
Rabbigh-fir lee

**Translation:**
O my Lord forgive me.

**Context:**
...and then supplicates:

title: When waking up (4/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جَسَدِي وَرَدٌ عَليّ روحي وَأَذِنَ لي بذكره

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih.

**Translation:**
All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.

title: When waking up (5/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
إنَّ فِي خَلْق السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْض واختلاف الليل والنهار لآيات لأولي الألباب ....

**Transliteration:**
Inna fee khalqi assamawati waal-ardi wa-ikhtilafi allayli wa-alnnahari la-ayatin li-olee al-albab...

**Instruction:**
Recite Verses 3:190-200 from Surah Ali Imran.

title: Supplication when wearing a garment
content:
**Arabic:**
الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا (الثوب) وَرَزَقْنيه مِنْ غَيْر حولٍ مني ولا قوة .

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.

**Translation:**
All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.

title: Supplication said when wearing a new garment
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ له، وَأَعودُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah.

**Translation:**
O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it, I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.

title: Supplication said to someone wearing a new garment (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
تبلي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

**Transliteration:**
Tublee wayukhliful-lahu taAAala.

**Translation:**
May you wear it out and Allah replace it with another.

**Note:**
The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.

title: Supplication said to someone wearing a new garment (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
البس جديداً وَعِشْ حَميداً وَمُتْ شهيداً

**Transliteration:**
Ilbas jadeedan waAAish hameedan wamut shaheedan.

**Translation:**
Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed (martyr).

title: Before undressing
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah.

title: Before entering the toilet
content:
**Arabic:**
(بسم الله ) اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ

**Transliteration:**
(Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith

**Translation:**
(In the name of Allah). O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.

title: After leaving the toilet
content:
**Arabic:**
غفرانك

**Transliteration:**
Ghufranak

**Translation:**
I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.

title: When starting ablution
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah.

title: Upon completing the ablution (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
أَشْهَدُ أن لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوله.

**Transliteration:**
Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh

**Translation:**
I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

title: Upon completing the ablution (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم اجعلني مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْني مِنَ المتطهرين.

**Transliteration:**
Allahummaj-AAalnee minat-tawwabeena wajAAalnee minal-mutatahhireen.

**Translation:**
O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.

title: Upon completing the ablution (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَكَ اللهُمَّ وَبِحَمدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أن لا إله إلا أنتَ اسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ .

**Transliteration:**
Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.

**Translation:**
How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.

title: When leaving the home (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ وَلَا حَولَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلا بالله

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

title: When leaving the home (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إني أعوذ بك أنْ أضِلَّ أو أضل ، أو أزل أو أزل ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أظلم ، أو أجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay.

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.

title: Upon entering the home
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله ولجنا ، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنا

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

title: Supplication when going to the mosque
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْ في قلبي نورا ، وفي لساني نورا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعي نورا، وَاجْعَلْ في بصري نورا، وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلفي نورا، وَمِنْ أمامي نورا، وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقي نورا ، وَمِن تَحْتي نورا . اللهم أعطني نورا .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma ijAAal fee qalbee noora, wafee lisanee noora, wajAAal fee samAAee noora, wajAAal fee basaree noora, wajAAal min khalfee noora, wamin amamee noora, wajAAal min fawqee noora, wamin tahtee noora, allahumma aAAtinee noora.

**Translation:**
O Allah, place within my heart light, and upon my tongue light, and within my ears light, and within my eyes light, and place behind me light and in front of me light and above me light and beneath me light O Allah, bestow upon me light.

title: Upon entering the mosque
content:
**Arabic:**
أعوذ بالله العظيم وبوجهه الكريم وسلطانه القديم مِنَ الشيطان الرجيم ، [ بسم الله، والصَّلاةُ] [وَالسَّلامُ عَلى رسول الله ، اللهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوابَ رَحْمَتِكَ

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu billahil-AAatheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah], allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.

**Translation:**
I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

title: Upon leaving the mosque
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله والصلاة والسّلامُ عَلى رسول الله، اللهم إني أسألُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللهُمَّ اعصمني مِنَ الشَّيْطان الرجيم.

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah, allahumma innee as-aluka min fadlik, allahumma iAAsimnee minash-shaytanir-rajeem.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.

title: Supplications related to the athan (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله.

**Transliteration:**
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah.

**Translation:**
There is no might nor power except with Allah.

**Instruction:**
Repeat what the mu-aththin says, except when he says 'Hayya AAala s-salah' or 'hayya AAalal-falah', say:

title: Supplications related to the athan (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
وأنا أشْهَدُ أنْ لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريك له ، وَأَنَّ محمّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوله ، رضيتُ باللهِ رَبَّا ، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً وبالإسلام ديناً

**Transliteration:**
Wa-ana ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh, radeetu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil-islami deena.

**Translation:**
And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.

**Instruction:**
Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin:

title: Supplications related to the athan (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَعْوَةِ التامة والصلاة القائمة آت محمَّداً الوسيلة والفضيلة وَابْعَثه مقاماً محموداً الَّذي وَعَدْتَه إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الميعاد.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma rabba hathihid-daAAwatit-tammah, wassalatil-qa-imah ati Muhammadan alwaseelata wal-fadeelah, wabAAath-hu maqaman mahmoodan allathee waAAadtah, innaka la tukhliful-meeAAad.

**Translation:**
O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.

**Instruction:**
After answering the call of the mu-aththin:

title: Supplication at the start of the prayer (1/6)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم باعد بيني وَبَيْنَ خَطاياي كما باعَدْتَ بَيْنَ المشرق والمَغْرِبُ ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ ، اللهُمَّ اغْسِلني مِنْ خَطاياي بالثلج والماءِ وَالْبَرَدْ .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma baAAid baynee wabayna khatayaya kama baAAadta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, allahumma naqqinee min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummagh-silnee min khatayaya biththalji walma-i walbarad.

**Translation:**
O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.

title: Supplication at the start of the prayer (2/6)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبحانَكَ اللهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعالى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ

**Transliteration:**
Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika watabarakas-muka wataAAala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruk.

**Translation:**
How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

title: Supplication at the start of the prayer (3/6)
content:
**Arabic:**
وَجَهتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذي فطر السمواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وما أنا مِنَ المشركين ...

**Transliteration:**
Wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana minal-mushrikeen...

**Translation:**
I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth...

title: Supplication at the start of the prayer (4/6)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ رَبَّ جبرائيل ، وميكائيل ، وَإسْرافيل، فاطِرَ السَّمواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israfeel fatiras-samawati walard...

**Translation:**
O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel...

title: Supplication at the start of the prayer (5/6)
content:
**Arabic:**
الله أكبر كبيرا ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبيرا ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera...

**Translation:**
Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great...

title: Supplication at the start of the prayer (6/6)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أنْتَ ُنورُ السَّمواتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فيهن ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma lakal-hamd anta noorus-samawati wal-ardi waman feehin...

**Translation:**
O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth...

**Instruction:**
When rising from sleep to perform prayers during the night:

title: While bowing in prayer (rukooAA) (1/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ رَبِّي العظيم .

**Transliteration:**
Subhana rabbiyal-AAatheem

**Translation:**
How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme (3 times).

title: While bowing in prayer (rukooAA) (2/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَكَ اللهُمَّ رَبَّنا وَبِحَمْدِكَ ، اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي

**Transliteration:**
Subhanakal-lahumma rabbana wabihamdik, allahummagh-fir lee

**Translation:**
How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.

title: While bowing in prayer (rukooAA) (3/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
سبوح قدوس ، رَبُّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوح .

**Transliteration:**
Subboohun quddoos, rabbul-mala-ikati warrooh.

**Translation:**
Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).

title: While bowing in prayer (rukooAA) (4/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وبك آمنت ، ولك أسلمت ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma laka rakaAAt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt...

**Translation:**
O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed...

title: While bowing in prayer (rukooAA) (5/5)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبحان ذي الجبروت ، والملكوت ، والكبرياء ، والعظمه

**Transliteration:**
Subhana thil-jabaroot, walmalakoot, walkibriya, walAAathamah.

**Translation:**
How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.

title: Upon rising from the bowing position (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
سمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَه .

**Transliteration:**
SamiAAal-lahu liman hamidah

**Translation:**
May Allah answer he who praises Him.

title: Upon rising from the bowing position (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
رَبَّنَا وَلكَ الحَمْدُ حَمْداً كثيراً طيباً مباركاً فيه

**Transliteration:**
Rabbana walakal-hamdu hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh.

**Translation:**
Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.

title: Upon rising from the bowing position (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
مِلْءَ السَّمواتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُما ...

**Transliteration:**
Mil-as-samawati wamil-al-ard, wama baynahuma...

**Translation:**
The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises...

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (1/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ رَبِّي الأعلى .

**Transliteration:**
Subhana rabbiyal-aAAla.

**Translation:**
How perfect my Lord is, The Most High (3 times).

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (2/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبحانَكَ اللهُمَّ رَبَّنا وَبِحَمْدِكَ ، اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي .

**Transliteration:**
Subhanakal-lahumma rabbana wabihamdik, allahummagh-fir lee.

**Translation:**
How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (3/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
سبوح قدوس، رَبُّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوح .

**Transliteration:**
Subbohoon quddos, rabbul-mala-ikati warrooh.

**Translation:**
Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh.

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (4/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبكَ آمنت ، ولك أسلمت ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma laka sajadt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt...

**Translation:**
O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed...

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (5/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبحان ذي الجبروت ، والملكوت ، والكبرياء ، والعظمه

**Transliteration:**
Subhana thil-jabaroot, walmalakoot, walkibriya, walAAathamah.

**Translation:**
How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (6/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي ذنبي كله ، دِقَهُ وَجِلَه ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lee thanbee kullah, diqqahu wajillah...

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them...

title: Supplication whilst prostrating (7/7)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك مِنْ سَخَطِكَ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure...

title: Supplication between the two prostrations (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي .

**Transliteration:**
Rabbigh-fir lee, rabbigh-fir lee.

**Translation:**
My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.

title: Supplication between the two prostrations (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ، وَارْحَمْنِي ، وَاهْدِنِي ، وَاجْبُرْنِي ، وَعافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَارْفَعْني

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee warfaAAnee.

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.

title: Supplication when prostrating due to recitation of the Quran (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سَجَدَ وَجْهي للذي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ ...

**Transliteration:**
Sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu...

**Translation:**
My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing...

title: Supplication when prostrating due to recitation of the Quran (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم اكتب لي بها عِنْدَكَ أجْراً ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummak-tub lee biha AAindaka ajra...

**Translation:**
O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration)...

title: The Tashahhud
content:
**Arabic:**
التَّحِيَّاتُ اللهِ وَالصَّلَواتُ والطَّيِّبات ...

**Transliteration:**
Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat...

**Translation:**
At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him...

title: Prayers upon the Prophet after the tashahhud (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحمَّد، وَعَلى آل مُحمَّد...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad...

**Translation:**
O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the followers of Muhammad...

title: Prayers upon the Prophet after the tashahhud (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِه...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatihi...

**Translation:**
O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (1/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إني أعوذ بكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (2/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهمَّ إِنِّي أعوذ بكَ مِنَ المَأْتَمِ وَالمَعْرَم .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma/thami walmaghram.

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (3/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee thalamtu nafsee thulman katheeran...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (4/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي ما قدَّمْتُ وَما أخرت ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lee ma qaddamtu, wama akhkhart...

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (5/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم أعني على ذكرك وشكرك ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma aAAinnee AAala thikrik, washukrik, wahusni AAibadatik.

**Translation:**
O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (6/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْل...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-bukhl...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (7/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألُكَ الجَنَّة وأعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النار .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar.

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (8/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبِ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلى الخَلق ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma biAAilmikal-ghayb, waqudratika AAalal-khalq...

**Translation:**
O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (9/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك يا الله بأنَّكَ الواحد الأحد ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-aluka ya Allah bi-annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samad...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (10/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك بأنَّ لكَ الْحَمْدُ لا إله إلا أَنْتَ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-aluka bianna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa ant...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise...

title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam (11/11)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك بأنّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنتَ اللهُ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma inne as-aluka biannee ashhadu annaka antallah...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah...

title: Remembrance after salam (1/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
أَسْتَغْفِرُ الله . (ثلاثا) اللهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلامُ ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلام ، تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام .

**Transliteration:**
Astaghfirullah (3 times). Allahumma antas-salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya thal-jalali wal-ikram.

**Translation:**
I ask Allah for forgiveness (3 times). O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

title: Remembrance after salam (2/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah...

title: Remembrance after salam (3/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له... لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah... la hawla wala quwwata illa billah...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah... There is no might nor power except with Allah...

title: Remembrance after salam (4/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ اللهِ ، والحَمْدُ لله ، والله أكبر .

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest (33 times).

title: Remembrance after salam (5/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهُوَ على كُلِّ شَيءٍ قدير

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner...

title: Remembrance after salam (6/9)
content:
**Instruction:**
Recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas after each prayer.

title: Remembrance after salam (7/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ ...

**Instruction:**
Recite Ayat-Al-Kursiy after each prayer.

title: Remembrance after salam (8/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له... (10 times after Maghrib & Fajr)

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah...

title: Remembrance after salam (9/9)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ علما نافعا ورزقاً طيباً ، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.

title: Supplication for seeking guidance (Al-Istikharah)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أستخيرك بعلمك ، وَاسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee astakheeruka biAAilmik, wa-astaqdiruka bi qudratik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power...

**Context:**
On the authority of Jabir Ibn AAabdullah, he said: The Prophet would instruct us to pray for guidance...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (1/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسى الملك لله وَالحَمدُ لله ...

**Transliteration:**
Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah...

**Translation:**
We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (2/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
أصْبَحْنا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ الله

**Transliteration:**
Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah...

**Translation:**
We have reached the morning...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (3/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم بك أصْبَحْنا وبك أمسينا ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna...

**Translation:**
O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (4/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant...

**Translation:**
O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (5/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أَشْهِدُك ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk...

**Translation:**
O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (6/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم ما أصْبَحَ بي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin...

**Translation:**
O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (7/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم عافني في بدني ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee...

**Translation:**
O Allah, grant my body health...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (8/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إني أعوذبك مِنَ الكفر ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (9/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
حسبي الله لا إله إلا هُوَ ...

**Transliteration:**
Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa...

**Translation:**
Allah is Sufficient for me...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (10/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
أعوذ بكلمات الله التاماتِ مِنْ شَرِّ ما خلق .

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

**Translation:**
I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil He has created.

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (11/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك العفو والعافية ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (12/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهادة ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah...

**Translation:**
O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (13/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله الذي لا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسمِهِ شَيْءٌ ...

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on...

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (14/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
رَضيتُ باللهِ رَبَّاً وبالإسلام ديناً ...

**Transliteration:**
Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan...

**Translation:**
I am pleased with Allah as a Lord...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (15/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِه ...

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi...

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (16/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ .

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (17/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
يا حي يا قيوم بِرَحْمَتِكِ أستغيث ...

**Transliteration:**
Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth...

**Translation:**
O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting... by Your mercy I seek assistance...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (18/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (19/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
أَصْبَحْنا وَأَصْبَحْ المُلكُ للهِ رَبِّ العالمين ...

**Transliteration:**
Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen...

**Translation:**
We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (20/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهُوَ على كُلِّ شَيءٍ قدير

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulk, walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

**Context:**
The messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever says in the morning:

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (21/22)
content:
**Arabic:**
أصْبَحْنا على فِطْرَةِ الإسلام ...

**Transliteration:**
Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam...

**Translation:**
We rise upon the fitrah of Islam...

title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening (22/22)
content:
**Context:**
'AAabdullah Ibn Khubaib said: 'The Messenger of Allah said to me 'Recite! ... Recite:

**Instruction:**
Recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas 3 times morning and evening.

title: Remembrance before sleeping (1/13)
content:
**Instruction:**
Spit in palms, recite last 3 chapters of Quran, wipe body (3 times).

title: Remembrance before sleeping (2/13)
content:
**Context:**
The Prophet also said:

**Instruction:**
Recite Ayat-al-Kursee.

title: Remembrance before sleeping (3/13)
content:
**Context:**
The Prophet also said:

**Instruction:**
Recite last two verses of Al-Baqarah.

title: Remembrance before sleeping (4/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبي ...

**Transliteration:**
Bismika rabbee wadaAAtu janbee...

**Translation:**
In Your name my Lord, I lie down...

title: Remembrance before sleeping (5/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلقت نَفْسي وَأَنْتَ تَوَقاها ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha...

**Translation:**
O Allah, verily You have created my soul...

title: Remembrance before sleeping (6/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبادك .

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma qinee AAathabaka yawma tabAAathu AAibadak.

**Translation:**
O Allah, protect me from Your punishment...

**Context:**
The Prophet would place his right hand under his cheek when about to sleep and supplicate:

title: Remembrance before sleeping (7/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
باسْمِكَ اللهُمَّ أموتُ وَأَحْيا .

**Transliteration:**
Bismikal-lahumma amootu wa-ahya.

**Translation:**
In Your name O Allah, I live and die.

title: Remembrance before sleeping (8/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ الله ... الحمد لله ... الله أكبر

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah... Alhamdu lillah... Allahu akbar

**Translation:**
How Perfect Allah is (33x), All praise is for Allah (33x), Allah is the greatest (34x).

**Context:**
When you go to bed say:

title: Remembrance before sleeping (9/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمواتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ العَرْش العظيم ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA...

**Translation:**
O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne...

title: Remembrance before sleeping (10/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي أطعمنا وسقانا...

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana...

**Translation:**
All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink...

title: Remembrance before sleeping (11/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ عالِم الغيب والشهادة ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah...

**Translation:**
O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen...

title: Remembrance before sleeping (12/13)
content:
**Context:**
The Prophet never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah and Soorat Al-Mulk

**Instruction:**
Recite Soorat As-Sajdah and Al-Mulk.

title: Remembrance before sleeping (13/13)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفسي إِلَيْكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I submit my soul unto You...

**Context:**
If you take to your bed, then perform ablution... and then supplicate:

title: Supplication when turning over during the night
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله الواحد القهار ...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar...

**Context:**
AAa-isha narrated that the Messenger of Allah used to say at night if he turned during sleep:

title: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness and the like during sleep
content:
**Arabic:**
أعوذ بكلمات الله التاماتِ مِن غَضَبِهِ ...

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih...

**Translation:**
I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger...

title: Upon seeing a good dream or a bad dream
content:
**Context:**
The righteous dream is from Allah and the bad dream is from the devil...

**Instruction:**
Spit on your left 3 times, seek refuge in Allah from shaytan, do not relate it, turn over.

title: Qunoot Al-Witr (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْت...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt...

**Translation:**
O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided...

title: Qunoot Al-Witr (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك مِنْ سَخَطِكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure...

title: Qunoot Al-Witr (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدْ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma iyyaka naAAbud...

**Translation:**
O Allah, it is You we worship...

title: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ المَلِكِ القدوس

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-malikil-quddoos.

**Translation:**
How perfect The King, The Holy One is.

**Context:**
...after giving salam he would supplicate three times:

title: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
رب الملائكة والروح

**Transliteration:**
Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.

**Translation:**
Lord of the angels and the Rooh.

**Context:**
...on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add:

title: Supplication for anxiety and sorrow (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I am Your servant...

title: Supplication for anxiety and sorrow (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَ الْحُزْن...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi wal huzn...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow...

title: Supplication for one in distress (1/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله العظيمُ الحَلِيم...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing...

title: Supplication for one in distress (2/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أرجو فلا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn...

**Translation:**
O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for...

title: Supplication for one in distress (3/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا أنت سُبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمين.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina th-thalimeen.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except You...

title: Supplication for one in distress (4/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّ لَا أَشْرِكْ بِهِ شَيْئاً.

**Transliteration:**
Allahu Allahu rabbi la oshriku bihi shaya.

**Translation:**
Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إنا نَجْعَلُكَ في نحورهم...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim...

**Translation:**
O Allah, we place You before them...

title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأنْتَ نَصيري...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree...

**Translation:**
O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper...

title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوكيل.

**Transliteration:**
Hasbunal-lahu waniAAmal-wakeel.

**Translation:**
Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee.

title: Supplication for one afflicted with doubt in his faith (1/3)
content:
**Context:**
He should seek refuge in Allah

title: Supplication for one afflicted with doubt in his faith (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Amantu billahi warusulih.

**Translation:**
I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.

**Context:**
He should say:

title: Supplication for one afflicted with doubt in his faith (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
هو الأولُ، وَالآخِرُ، وَالظَّاهِرُ، وَالْباطِنُ...

**Transliteration:**
Huwa al-awwalu, wa al-akhiru, wa alththahiru wa albatinu...

**Translation:**
He is The First and The Last...

**Context:**
He should also recite the following verse:

title: Settling a debt (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرامِكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me...

title: Settling a debt (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَ الْحُزْن...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi wal huzn...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow...

title: Supplication for one afflicted by whisperings in prayer or recitation
content:
**Context:**
Othman Ibn Al-AAas narrated... The Messenger of Allah replied 'That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit on your left side three times.

title: Supplication for one whose affairs have become difficult
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم لا سهل إلا ما جَعَلْتَهُ سَهلا ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla...

**Translation:**
O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy...

title: Upon committing a sin
content:
**Context:**
Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer... and then seeks Allah's forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.

title: Supplication for expelling the devil and his whisperings (1/3)
content:
**Instruction:**
Seeking refuge from him.

title: Supplication for expelling the devil and his whisperings (2/3)
content:
**Instruction:**
The athan (call to prayer).

title: Supplication for expelling the devil and his whisperings (3/3)
content:
**Instruction:**
Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts...

**Note:**
Do not make your homes like the graveyards...

title: Supplication when stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
قدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَل

**Transliteration:**
Qaddaral-lah, wama shaa faAAal.

**Translation:**
Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

**Context:**
The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah... If a mishap should happen to befall you then do not say 'If only I had acted...'. Rather, say:

title: Supplication when stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيل

**Transliteration:**
Hasbiyal-lah, waniAAmal-wakeel.

**Translation:**
Allah is sufficient for me, and how fine a trustee.

**Context:**
Indeed Allah rebukes negligence... but if a matter should overtake you then say:

title: Placing children under Allah's protection
content:
**Arabic:**
أعيدكما بكلمات الله التامة...

**Transliteration:**
OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah...

**Translation:**
I commend you two to the protection of Allah's perfect words...

**Context:**
Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah's protection, saying:

title: When visiting the sick (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا بأس طهور إنْ شَاءَ الله

**Transliteration:**
La ba/sa tahoorun in shaal-lah.

**Translation:**
Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.

**Context:**
When the Prophet would enter upon a sick person, he would say:

title: When visiting the sick (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
أَسْأَلُ الله العظيم، رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظيم أن يشفيك .

**Transliteration:**
Asalul-lahal-AAatheem rabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem an yashfeek.

**Translation:**
I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you.

**Context:**
Any Muslim servant who visits a sick person... and supplicates seven times:

title: Supplication of the sick who have renounced all hope of life (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْنِي وَالحقني بالرفيق الأعلى

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee wa-alhiqnee birrafeeqil-aAAla.

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the higher companions.

title: Supplication of the sick who have renounced all hope of life (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله، إِنَّ للمَوْتِ السكرات.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, death does indeed contain agony.

**Context:**
AAaishah related that the Prophet (during his illness...) would wipe his face and say:

title: Supplication of the sick who have renounced all hope of life (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest...

title: Instruction for the one nearing death
content:
**Context:**
He whose last words are:

**Instruction:**
Encourage him to say the shahadah: La ilaha illal-lah.

title: Supplication for one afflicted by a calamity
content:
**Arabic:**
إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ راجعون ...

**Transliteration:**
Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon...

**Translation:**
To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return...

title: When closing the eyes of the deceased
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لفلان باسمه ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir li-(name of dead)...

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive (name)...

title: Supplication for the deceased at the funeral prayer (1/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh...

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him...

title: Supplication for the deceased at the funeral prayer (2/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنا وَمَيِّتِنا ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina...

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive our living and our dead...

title: Supplication for the deceased at the funeral prayer (3/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلانَ بْنَ فلان في ذِمَّتِكَ ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma inna (name) fee thimmatik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care...

title: Supplication for the deceased at the funeral prayer (4/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُم عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik...

**Translation:**
O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant...

title: Supplication for the advancement of reward during the funeral prayer (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وذخراً لوالديه...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh...

**Translation:**
O Allah, make him a preceding reward and a stored treasure for his parents...

**Context:**
This supplication is made when the deceased is a baby/child

title: Supplication for the advancement of reward during the funeral prayer (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم اجعله لنا فرطا، وسلفا وأجْراً.

**Transliteration:**
Allahummaj-AAalhu lana farata, wasalafan wa-ajra.

**Translation:**
O Allah, make him a preceding reward, a prepayment and a recompense for us.

**Context:**
Al-Hasan used to recite the opening chapter... and then supplicates:

title: Condolence (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
إِنَّ الله ما أخذ وله ما أعطى...

**Transliteration:**
Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta...

**Translation:**
Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave...

title: Condolence (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
أعظم اللهُ أَجْرَك ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَ كَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ.

**Transliteration:**
aAAthamal-lahu ajrak, wa-ahsana AAazaak, waghafara limayyitik.

**Translation:**
May Allah magnify your reward, make better your solace and forgive your deceased.

**Context:**
...and one can also say:

title: Placing the deceased in the grave
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم اللهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسول الله .

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lahi waAAala sunnati rasoolil-lah.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

title: After burying the deceased
content:
**Context:**
After the Prophet would bury the deceased he would stand by the grave and say:

**Instruction:**
Seek forgiveness for your brother and pray that he remains firm.

title: Visiting the graves
content:
**Arabic:**
السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيارِ مِنَ المُؤمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِين...

**Transliteration:**
Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen...

**Translation:**
Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves...

title: Prayer said during a wind storm (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَها ، وأعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّها.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You for it's goodness and I take refuge with You from it's evil.

title: Prayer said during a wind storm (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَها ، وَخَيْرَ ما فيها...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You for it's goodness, the good within it...

title: Supplication upon hearing thunder
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ الَّذي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ، وَالملائكة من خيفته.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-raAAdu bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih.

**Translation:**
How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise...

**Context:**
When AAabdullah Ibn Az-Zubayr used to hear thunder he would stop talking and say:

title: Supplication for rain (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ اسْقِنا غَيْثا مغيثاً مريئاً مريعاً...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan...

**Translation:**
O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain...

title: Supplication for rain (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم أغثنا، اللهُمَّ أَغِثنا، اللهم أغثنا.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna.

**Translation:**
O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.

title: Supplication for rain (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ اسْقَ عِبادَكَ وَبَهَائِمَكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak...

**Translation:**
O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle...

title: Supplication said when it rains
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهمَّ صَيِّباً نافعاً

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma sayyiban nafiAAa.

**Translation:**
O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.

title: After rainfall
content:
**Arabic:**
مطرنا بفضل اللهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Mutirna bifadlil-lahi warahmatih.

**Translation:**
We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

title: Asking for clear skies
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ حَوالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنا...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna...

**Translation:**
O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us...

title: Upon sighting the crescent moon
content:
**Arabic:**
الله أكبر، اللهُمَّ أهْلَهُ عَلَيْنا بالأمن والإيمان...

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman...

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace...

title: Upon breaking fast (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
ذَهَبَ الظَّمَا، وَابْتَلَتِ العُروق...

**Transliteration:**
Thahabath-thama-o wabtallatil-AAurooq...

**Translation:**
The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched...

title: Upon breaking fast (2/3)
content:
**Context:**
AAabdullah Ibn AAamr Ibn Al-AAas related that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Indeed the fasting person has at the time of breaking fast, a supplication which is not rejected'.

title: Upon breaking fast (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ التي وَسِعَت كُلَّ شيء...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things...

title: Supplication before eating (1/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah.

**Context:**
When you are about to eat, you should say:

title: Supplication before eating (2/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم اللهِ في أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِره .

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah in it's beginning and end.

**Context:**
...and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say:

title: Supplication before eating (3/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم بارك لنا فيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْه.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.

**Translation:**
O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.

**Context:**
Whomever Allah feeds, should say:

title: Supplication before eating (4/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم بارك لنا فيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْه.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.

**Translation:**
O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

**Context:**
....and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:

title: Upon completing the meal (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي أطعمني هذا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ ...

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi...

**Translation:**
All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me...

title: Upon completing the meal (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كثيراً طيباً مباركا فيه...

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh...

**Translation:**
Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise...

title: Supplication of the guest for the host
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم بارك لهُمْ فيما رَزَقْتَهُم ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.

**Translation:**
O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.

title: Supplication said to one offering a drink
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ أَطْعِم مَن أطعمني، وَاسْق من سقاني.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee.

**Translation:**
O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.

title: Supplication said when breaking fast in someone's home
content:
**Arabic:**
أقطر عندكم الصائمون وأكل طعامكم الأبرار ، وصلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ المَلائِكَة.

**Transliteration:**
Aftara AAindakumus-sa-imoon, wa-akala taAAamakumul-abrar, wasallat AAalaykumul-mala-ikah.

**Translation:**
May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.

title: Supplication said by one fasting when presented with food
content:
**Instruction:**
If you are not invited then answer. If you are fasting then supplicate; if not then eat.

title: Supplication said upon seeing the early or premature fruit
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم بارك لنا في تمرنا، وبارك لنا في مدينتنا...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina...

**Translation:**
O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us...

title: Supplication said upon sneezing (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ للهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillah.

**Translation:**
All praise if for Allah.

**Context:**
When one of you sneezes he should say:

title: Supplication said upon sneezing (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
يَرْحَمُكَ الله.

**Transliteration:**
Yarhamukal-lah.

**Translation:**
May Allah have mercy upon you.

**Context:**
...and his brother or companion should say to him:

title: Supplication said upon sneezing (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بالكم.

**Transliteration:**
Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.

**Translation:**
May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

**Context:**
...and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:

title: Supplication said to the newlywed
content:
**Arabic:**
بارك الله لك، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُما فِي خَيْرٍ

**Transliteration:**
Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.

**Translation:**
May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.

title: The groom's supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَها، وَخَيْرَ ما جَبَلْتَها عَلَيْه...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh...

**Translation:**
O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards...

**Context:**
when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:

title: Supplication before sexual intercourse
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله اللهُمَّ جَنَّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنْبِ الشَّيْطَانَ ما رزقتنا.

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.

title: When angry
content:
**Arabic:**
أعوذُ باللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّحِيم

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.

**Translation:**
I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

title: Supplication said upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ لله الذي عافاني مِمَّا ابْتَلاكَ به...

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih...

**Translation:**
All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with...

**Context:**
This supplication is to be said to one's self, not directly to the one in trial or tribulation.

title: Remembrance said at a sitting or gathering
content:
**Arabic:**
رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي، وتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفور.

**Transliteration:**
Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.

**Translation:**
O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me. Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.

**Context:**
Ibn AAumar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up:

title: Supplication for the expiation of sins said at the conclusion of a sitting (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَكَ اللهُمَّ وَبِحَمدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أن لا إله إلا أنتَ ...

**Transliteration:**
Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant...

**Translation:**
How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You...

title: Supplication for the expiation of sins said at the conclusion of a sitting (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَكَ وَيَحَمدِك، لا إله إلا أنتَ أسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanaka wabi hamdik, la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa -atoobu ilayk.

**Translation:**
How perfect You are and I praise You None has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You

**Context:**
AAaishah said: Whenever The Messenger of Allah would betake a seat, read Quran or pray, he would always conclude it with certain words...

title: Returning a supplication of forgiveness (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
غَفَرَ اللهُ لكَ يا رسول الله.

**Transliteration:**
Ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.

**Translation:**
May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.

**Context:**
AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis said: 'I went to see the Prophet and ate from his food and then said to him:

title: Returning a supplication of forgiveness (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
ولك .

**Transliteration:**
wa-lak

**Translation:**
and you.

**Context:**
...he replied:

title: Supplication said to one who does you a favour
content:
**Arabic:**
جَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً.

**Transliteration:**
Jazakal-lahu khayran.

**Translation:**
May Allah reward you with goodness.

**Context:**
If someone does you a favour and you say:

title: Protection from the Dajjal (1/2)
content:
**Instruction:**
Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.

title: Protection from the Dajjal (2/2)
content:
**Instruction:**
One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.

title: Supplication said to one who pronounces his love for you, for Allah's sake
content:
**Arabic:**
أَحَبَّكَ الذي أَحْبَبْتَني له.

**Transliteration:**
Ahabbakal-lathee ahbabtanee lah.

**Translation:**
May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.

title: Supplication said to one who has offered you some of his wealth
content:
**Arabic:**
بارك اللهُ لكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِك.

**Transliteration:**
Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik.

**Translation:**
May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.

title: Supplication said to the debtor when his debt is settled
content:
**Arabic:**
بارك اللهُ لكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِك، إنَّما جَزاءُ السَّلفِ الْحَمْدُ والأداء.

**Transliteration:**
Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada.

**Translation:**
May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.

title: Supplication for fear of shirk
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم إني أعوذبك أن أشرك بك وأنا أعْلَمْ، وَاسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أعلم.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam.

**Translation:**
O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.

title: Returning a supplication after having bestowed a gift (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
بارك الله فيكم.

**Transliteration:**
Barakal-lahu feekum.

**Translation:**
May Allah bless you all.

**Context:**
AAaishah reported that... When the servant would come back... he replied: They would supplicate:

title: Returning a supplication after having bestowed a gift (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
وفيهم بارك الله.

**Transliteration:**
Wafeehim barakal-lah.

**Translation:**
and may Allah bless them.

**Context:**
...AAaishah would then say:

title: Forbiddance of ascribing things to omens
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم لا طير إلا طيرك، ولا خَيْرَ إلا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.

**Translation:**
O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

**Context:**
This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil... but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says:

title: Supplication said when mounting an animal or any means of transport
content:
**Arabic:**
بسْمِ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لله، سُبْحانَ الَّذي سَخَّرَ لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لمنقلبون، الحَمْدُ لله، الحَمْدُ لله، الحَمْدُ لله، الله أكبر، الله أكبر ، اللهُ أَكْبَر، سُبْحَانَكَ اللهُمَّ إنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفسي فَاغْفِرْ لي فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوب إلا أنت.

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah, walhamdu lillah, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanakal-lahumma innee thalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fainnahu la yaghfiru th-thunooba illa ant.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.

title: Supplication for travel (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الله أكبر ، الله أكبر ، الله أكبر ، سُبْحانَ الَّذي سَخَّرَ لنا هذا وما كُنَّا لَهُ مُقرنين...

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha...

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is...

title: Supplication for travel (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون

**Transliteration:**
Ayiboona, ta-iboona, AAabidoona, lirabbina hamidoon.

**Translation:**
We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.

**Note:**
Upon returning add:

title: Supplication upon entering a town or village
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمواتِ السَّبْع وما أظللن ...

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAAi wama athlaln...

**Translation:**
O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop...

title: When entering the market
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد ...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner...

title: Supplication for when the mounted animal stumbles
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله .

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah.

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah.

title: Supplication of the traveller for the resident
content:
**Arabic:**
أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذي لا تَضيعُ وَدَائِعُه.

**Transliteration:**
AstawdiAAukumul-lah, allathee la tadeeAAu wada-iAAuh.

**Translation:**
I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

title: Supplication of the resident for the traveller (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
أسْتَوْدِعُ اللهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمانَتَكَ، وَخَواتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ.

**Transliteration:**
AstawdiAAul-laha deenak, wa amanatak, wakhawateema AAamalik.

**Translation:**
I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

title: Supplication of the resident for the traveller (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
زَوَّدَكَ اللهُ التقوى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْتُمَا كُنت.

**Transliteration:**
Zawwadakal-lahut-taqwa, waghafara thanbak, wayassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunt.

**Translation:**
May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

title: Remembrance while ascending or descending (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الله أكبر .

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar.

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
Jabir said: While ascending, we would say:

title: Remembrance while ascending or descending (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبحان الله .

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is.

**Context:**
...and when descending, we would say:

title: Prayer of the traveller as dawn approaches
content:
**Arabic:**
سَمِعَ سَامِعُ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْن بَلائِهِ عَلَيْنا...

**Transliteration:**
SamiAAa samiAAun bihamdil-lahi wahusni bala-ihi AAalayna...

**Translation:**
May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours...

title: Stopping or lodging somewhere
content:
**Arabic:**
أعوذ بكلماتِ الله التاماتِ مِنْ شَرِّ ما خلق.

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

**Translation:**
I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil that He has created.

title: While returning from travel (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الله أكبر، اللهُ أَكْبَر، اللهُ أَكْبَر.

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
Ibn AAumar reported that the Messenger of Allah... would say at every high point:

title: While returning from travel (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له... آيبون تائبون...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah... ayiboona ta-iboon...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah... We return, repent...

**Context:**
...and then he would say:

title: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحات

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahil-lathee biniAAmatihi tatimmu s-salihat.

**Translation:**
All Praise is for Allah by whose favour good works are accomplished.

**Context:**
When he used to receive pleasant news, he would say:

title: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ اللهِ على كل حال.

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillahi AAala kulli hal.

**Translation:**
All Praise is for Allah in all circumstances.

**Context:**
...and upon receiving displeasing news, he would say:

title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (1/3)
Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (2/3)
Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet (3/3)
Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting (1/3)
Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting (2/3)
Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting (3/3)
Supplication said upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of an ass
content:
**Instruction:**
If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty. If you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah.

title: Supplication upon hearing the barking of dogs at night
content:
**Instruction:**
Seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.

title: Supplication said for one you have insulted
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُربة إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma fa-ayyuma mu/minin sababtuhu fajAAal thalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah.

**Translation:**
O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.

title: The etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim
content:
**Instruction:**
Say: I deem so-and-so to be... and Allah is his reckoner...

title: Supplication said between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
content:
**Arabic:**
رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

**Transliteration:**
Rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhirati hasanatan waqina AAathaba alnnar

**Translation:**
O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

title: Supplication said when at Mount Safa & Mount Marwah (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
إِنَّ الصَّفَا والمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شعائر الله .... أَبْدَأَ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Innas-safa wa-almarwata min shaAAa-iri Allah.... Abda-o bima badaal-lahu bih.

**Translation:**
Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah... I begin with what Allah began with.

**Context:**
Jabir said... '...and when he approached mount Safa he recited:

title: Supplication said when at Mount Safa & Mount Marwah (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
...so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the KaAAbah, he then faced it and said:

title: Supplication said when at Mount Safa & Mount Marwah (3/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك ولهُ الحَمْدُ وهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ...

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd...

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner...

**Context:**
...and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time:

title: The Day of AAarafah
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.

**Context:**
'The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of AAarafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is):

title: At the Sacred Site (Al-MashAAar Al-Haram)
content:
**Instruction:**
Face the qiblah, supplicate to Allah, and extol His greatness and oneness.

title: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُ أَكْبَرُ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar.

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
Every time the Prophet threw a pebble at any of the three jamarat, he would say:

title: At the black stone
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهُ أَكْبَرُ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar.

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
The Prophet circled the KaAAbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say:

title: Supplication made against an enemy
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الكِتَابِ سَريعَ الحِسابِ اهْزِمَ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمُهُمْ وَزَلْزِلَهُمْ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma munzilal kitab, sareeAAal-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum.

**Translation:**
O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.

title: What to say when in fear of a people
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ.

**Transliteration:**
Allahummak-fineehim bima shi/t.

**Translation:**
O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.

title: What to say at times of amazement and delight (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ !

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah!

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is.

title: What to say at times of amazement and delight (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
الله أكبر !

**Transliteration:**
Allahu akbar.

**Translation:**
Allah is the greatest.

title: What to do upon receiving pleasant news
content:
**Instruction:**
The Prophet would prostrate in gratitude to Allah.

title: What to say and do when feeling some pain in the body (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله (ثلاثا)

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah (three times)

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah (three times).

**Context:**
Place your hand at the site of the pain and say:

title: What to say and do when feeling some pain in the body (2/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
أعُودُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مَنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأَحَاذِرُ. (سبع مرات)

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu billahi waqudratih min sharri ma ajidu wa-ohathir. (seven times).

**Translation:**
I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.

**Context:**
...the supplicate seven times:

title: What to say when in fear of afflicting something or someone with ones eye (1/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم بارك عليه.

**Transliteration:**
Allahumma barik AAalayh.

**Translation:**
O Allah, send blessing upon him.

**Context:**
From the supplications for the protection against the Evil Eye:

title: What to say when in fear of afflicting something or someone with ones eye (2/3)
content:
**Arabic:**
ما شاء الله، لا قُوَّةَ إلا بالله.

**Transliteration:**
Ma shaal-lah, la quwwata illa billah.

**Translation:**
(this is) that which Allah has willed, there is no power except with Allah.

title: What to say when in fear of afflicting something or someone with ones eye (3/3)
content:
**Context:**
If you see something from your brother, yourself or wealth which you find impressing, then invoke blessings for it...

title: Etiquette of retiring for the night
content:
**Instruction:**
Restrain children at Maghrib, shut doors, tie water-skins, cover vessels, put out lamps, mentioning Allah's name.

title: The Talbiyah
content:
**Arabic:**
لبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لا شَريكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ...

**Transliteration:**
Labbaykal-lahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk...

**Translation:**
Here I am O Allah, here I am...

title: What to say when startled
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

title: What is said to a Kafir when he sneezes
content:
**Arabic:**
يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.

**Transliteration:**
Yahdeekum wayuslihu balakum.

**Translation:**
May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

title: Returning a greeting to a Kafir
content:
**Arabic:**
وعليكم.

**Transliteration:**
WaAAalaykum.

**Translation:**
And upon you.

**Context:**
When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying:

title: When insulted while fasting
content:
**Arabic:**
إنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ.

**Transliteration:**
Innee sa-im, innee sa-im.

**Translation:**
I am fasting, I am fasting.

title: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
content:
**Arabic:**
بسم الله واللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي.

**Transliteration:**
Bismil-lah wallahu akbar, allahumma minka walak, allahumma taqabbal minnee

**Translation:**
In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.

title: What is said to ward off the deception of the Obstinate Shaytans
content:
**Arabic:**
أَعُودُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ ولا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ...

**Transliteration:**
aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat, allatee la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajir min sharri ma khalaq...

**Translation:**
I take refuge within Allah's perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress...

title: Seeking forgiveness and repentance (2/4)
content:
**Arabic:**
اسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِي لا إلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأتُوبُ إِلَيهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Astaghfirul-lahal-lathee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa-atoobu ilayh.

**Translation:**
I seek Allah's forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting... and I turn to Him in repentance.

**Context:**
He also said: 'Whoever says:

title: Seeking forgiveness and repentance (4/4)
content:
**Context:**
He also said: 'verily my heart becomes preoccupied...

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (1/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك ولهُ الحَمْد، وهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيءٍ قدير. (مائة مرة).

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer (one hundred times)

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise...

**Context:**
Whoever says... a hundred times during the day:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (2/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ. مائة مرة في اليوم)

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih. (one hundred times daily)

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

**Context:**
Whoever says... a hundred times during the day:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (3/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وبِحَمْدِهِ حين يصبح وحين يمسي)

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih. (at morning & evening time)

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

**Context:**
Whoever says at morning and evening time:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (4/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ وهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partener. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

**Context:**
Aboo Ayyoob Al-Ansaree related that The Prophet said: 'Whoever says:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (5/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيم.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, wasubhanal-lahil-AAatheem.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.

**Context:**
Aboo Hurayrah reported... '(There are) Two words, (which are) light on the tongue...

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (6/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ لله، لا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
