Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Saying:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (7/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is.

**Context:**
Sa'd said... 'Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?'... 'He should say:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (8/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lahil-AAatheemi wabihamdih.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him.

**Context:**
Jabbir related that the Prophet said: 'Whoever says:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (9/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا حولَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ.

**Transliteration:**
La hawla wala quwwata illa billah.

**Translation:**
There is no might nor power except with Allah.

**Context:**
AAabdullah Ibn Qays related... 'O 'AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?' He then said: 'Say:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (10/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ للهِ ، ولا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.

**Context:**
the most beloved words to Allah are four:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (11/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، الله أكبر كبيرا والحَمْدُ لله كثيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العالمين، لا حَولَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلا بالله العزيز الحكيم.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, subhanal-lahi rabbil-AAalameen, la hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAazeezil-hakeem.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah...

**Context:**
SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: 'Teach me something which I should say?' He said: 'Say:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (12/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ، وارْحَمْنِي، واهْدِنِي، وارزقني.

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, warzuqnee

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance

**Context:**
...the man then said: 'These are for my Lord, and what is for me?' He replied: 'Say:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (13/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
اللهم اغفر لي، وارْحَمْنِي، واهْدِنِي، وعَافِنِي وارزقني.

**Transliteration:**
Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, waAAafinee warzuqnee

**Translation:**
O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.

**Context:**
Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said: 'When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (14/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
الْحَمْدُ للهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Alhamdu lillah

**Translation:**
All praise is for Allah.

**Context:**
Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Verily, the best supplication is:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (15/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
لا إله إلا الله.

**Transliteration:**
La ilaha illal-lah.

**Translation:**
None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

**Context:**
...and indeed, the best form of remembrance is:

title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah (16/16)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ لله، لا إلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا حَولَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.

**Translation:**
How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no might nor power except with Allah.

**Context:**
'The everlasting righteous deeds:

title: How the prophet made tasbeeh (1/2)
content:
**Arabic:**
سُبْحانَ الله، الحَمْدُ لله، اللهُ أَكْبَر.

**Transliteration:**
Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.

**Context:**
Tasbeeh, it means here, to say:
